title_en: CORNER COMMERCIAL UNIT FOR SALE IN KINOBLOCK RESIDENCE, PORCELAIN!!
description_en: KinoBlock Residence Residential and service complex consisting of 5 towers of 10 floors and 2 floors of underground parking. This project is organized with green spaces, connecting roads with the new buildings. The service facilities project for the Health Center, Kindergarten, 9-Year-Old School and the newly completed High School is also being developed nearby. The area is currently in the development stage, like all the new complexes that are being built, but also because of the big ring which has started the works and adds value and access to the area. General information: * Location: Kinoblock Residence in Rrugen e Kokonozeve, Porcelan * Positioned overlooking the main road * Corner Openspace unit on floor 0 with internal access to parking floor -1 (warehouse/storage/refrigerated room). * 10m glass facade in the NW and 15m glass facade in the SW * Floor 0= 191.64 m2 (in total 2 rooms joined and made openspace) and Utilization space= 151.5 m2 * Floor -1= 107.12 m2 * Height of floor 0 = 5m * Height of floor -1 = 4m For more information, please contact me!
